plugins.name: AIStudio2API
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI native C ABI plugin that exposes Google AI Studio Playground and Build channels as OpenAI, Responses, Claude and Gemini APIs, with an in-process SpiderMonkey BotGuard WAA engine and multi-account cooldown-aware scheduling.
plugins.author: jianli9158

zh-CN.description: 将 Google AI Studio 的 Playground 与 Build 双通道以 OpenAI / Responses / Claude / Gemini 四种协议对外提供，内置进程中 SpiderMonkey BotGuard WAA 签名引擎，支持多账号权益分级与冷却调度，并可在控制台一键拉起本机 Chrome 完成 OAuth 登录。

plugins.name: FreeTier 2API
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI native plugin that turns free-tier quotas from 15 AI coding assistants (WorkBuddy, AutoClaw, Qoder, Raccoon, OpenCode ZEN, Cline, ZCode, Trae, CodeArts, MiniMax Code) into OpenAI, Responses and Anthropic APIs, with an embedded web console for OAuth/API-key accounts, quota tracking, check-in and cross-provider load balancing.
plugins.author: cxy2730

zh-CN.description: 将 15 个国内外免费额度 AI 编程助手（WorkBuddy、AutoClaw、Qoder、小浣熊、OpenCode ZEN、Cline、ZCode、Trae、CodeArts、MiniMax Code）统一接入为 OpenAI / Responses / Anthropic 接口，内置 Web 控制台管理 OAuth 与 API Key 账号、额度可视化、自动签到，并支持跨供应商同名模型负载均衡与故障转移。

plugins.name: Doujie OAuth
plugins.description: Unofficial Doujie (doubao) provider for CLIProxyAPI: explicit domestic, Dola international QR sign-in entries plus Windows desktop session import. Adds model discovery, native Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions and OpenAI Responses execution, 5h/7d quota windows and reset cards. Regions never switch automatically. Not affiliated with any commercial trademark.
plugins.author: wangxiaoshuai136

zh-CN.description: 非官方豆姐（Doujie）提供商插件：新增 doubao provider，提供国内版、Dola 国际版两个独立扫码入口以及 Windows 桌面会话导入，支持模型发现、Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses 原生执行，并展示真实 5h/7d 配额窗口与重置卡核销。地区不会自动切换；与相关公司及商标无隶属或背书关系。

zh-TW.description: 非官方豆姐（Doujie）提供者外掛：新增 doubao provider，提供國內版與 Dola 國際版兩個獨立掃碼入口，以及 Windows 桌面工作階段匯入，支援模型探索、Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Chat Completions 與 Responses 原生執行，並顯示真實 5h/7d 配額視窗與重置卡。地區不會自動切換；與相關公司及商標無隸屬或背書關係。
